nodes.body: **High Resolutions Lack Validation** The pixel-based curve applies its single 1080p calibration to every resolution, reducing source-quality 4K exports from 80 Mbps to 14.4 Mbps. However, the real-encoder regressions cover only the 1080p “good” preset. Please add representative high-resolution and source-quality coverage so dense text or motion at the largest bitrate reduction cannot become unreadable without detection.

**Ceiling Is Platform Specific** This always-on byte ceiling comes from a macOS Metal hardware-encoder run, while CI runs Chromium on Ubuntu and the exporter may choose a different hardware encoder or fall back to software VBR. If that encoder produces a larger valid output for the same budget, this machine-specific assertion will fail CI. Please validate a portable invariant or derive the bound from the CI encoder.
